I am writing to express my strong interest in the Research Associate I position at the San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance. With a background in research and over six years of experience in data science and technical problem-solving, I have developed a strong foundation in analyzing records, managing data, and optimizing research workflows.

My conceptual understanding of scientific methods, combined with technical expertise in database systems, allows me to effectively collect, collate, and analyze data for the Conservation Genetics team. I am skilled in documentation and maintaining organized records, and I have a proven track record of collaborating with teams to ensure operational efficiency and rigorous attention to detail.

I am particularly drawn to this role because of my interest in stem cell applications and the innovative work of the Frozen Zoo. I am adaptable, eager to contribute to multiple aspects of the lab’s work, and dedicated to the mission of saving species through technology and science.

You can find my portfolio and publications at www.lmgb.xyz. Thank you for your consideration.
